subject: ela
skillName: Identify front cover and title page
intro: Pick the part of the book.

items.prompt:
The part you see first, with the title, is the:
A) Back cover
B) Front cover
C) Last page

The part at the very end is the:
A) Front cover
B) Back cover
C) Title page

The front cover shows the:
A) Last word
B) Title
C) Page numbers

steps: Front shows the title. Key is B.

items.prompt:
The page inside that shows the title and author is the:
A) Back cover
B) Title page
C) Middle page

steps: Inside title page. Key is B.

items.prompt:
To start reading, you open the:
A) Back cover
B) Front cover
C) Last page

steps: Open the front. Key is B.

items.prompt:
The story pages are between the:
A) Two covers
B) Two titles
C) Two authors

steps: Between front and back. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Which part comes in this order: front cover, then ____, then the story?
A) Back cover
B) Title page
C) The end

steps: Title page is near the front, before the story. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Where would you look to find the title AND the author inside the book?
A) The back cover only
B) The title page
C) The last page

steps: Title page shows both. Key is B.
